name: Nestlé (Malaysia) Berhad
summary: Nestlé (Malaysia) Berhad manufactures food and beverage products in Malaysia and internationally, marketing brands including Milo, Maggi, Nescafé, and KitKat. The company was founded in 1912 and is headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia, operating as a subsidiary of Nestlé S.A.
